name: adarsh-mobile-shell
description: Capacitor native shell that loads the Adarsh mobile PWA for Android and iOS.

scripts.sync: npm run prepare && npx cap sync
scripts.copy: npm run prepare && npx cap copy
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
